scope: Ten representative venues near Nagoya Station, Fushimi and Sakae. Not exhaustive, not ranked, not a availability search.

verification_policy.verified_official: A specific factual field was read on a current official venue/operator page; this is not a blanket quality or operating-status certification.
verification_policy.unknown: Not established in this bounded pass; never display as false/no.
verification_policy.coordinates: No exact coordinate was independently verified. Public UI must not present the provider coordinates as verified navigation pins.
verification_policy.private_room: Private, semi-private and movable-partition room categories remain distinct; soundproofing never inferred.
verification_policy.budgets: Published course evidence only. Null ceiling means no upper bound verified, not free/unlimited. Room fees, service, tax and drinks must retain their qualifiers.

openpoi.coverage_note: These are two targeted discovery queries, not an exhaustive local inventory. Five of ten selected venues have candidate OpenPOI matches.
